notes.title: Me Smart Orc is LIVE on all platforms!
notes.content:
That's right kids, you too can be a flying lizard!

We're live on Steam now.

And for Mac and Linux users, try it online at http://textadventures.co.uk/games/view/8vjkldeul0ackq-ve_nxfw/me-smart-orc

The game is short, intentionally so. But it has some replayability, as your options change based on how smart your orc is, and things like rewards and RNG can be changed or avoided based on your decisions.

If people like it, I'll try to add more encounters, possibly even different perspectives, as time goes on. Thanks for your love! <3

notes.title: Me Smart Orc packaged, tested, and ready for launch!
notes.content:
I'm happy to say that our short text adventure, 'Me Smart Orc', has passed testing and should be released right on time.

It's a short game, consisting of a dozen or so rooms. However, the game options change based on how smart your orc is at any given time. There's about 36K words of text packed in there, though you won't see it all on a single play through.

If people enjoy the concept, free additions to the core game are quite likely. I had to stop writing 'Me Smart Orc' so that I could start writing the first book in the second Panos trilogy. That one should be out for the holidays.

Until then, enjoy being a flying lizard!
